facts.business: Gayatri Sugars Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar and operates sugar units at Kamareddy and Nizamsagar in Telangana, along with a distillery unit.

auditor.name: MOS & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision of estimated electricity duty of Rs. 283.99 Lakhs treated as contingent liability, as per note 29.16, regarding High Court and Supreme Court dismissal of petitions challenging levy of electricity duty on captive generation.

key_risks: Contingent liability of Rs. 283.99 Lakhs for electricity duty on captive consumption pending legal resolution
Customs, Excise and Service Tax demand of Rs. 80.29 Lakhs for Nizamsagar Unit pending before CESTAT
High leverage with secured borrowings and promoter pledges
Dependence on related party loans and corporate guarantees
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY 2025-26 were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business; no materially significant transactions with promoters, directors, KMPs. Company received Rs. 898.08 lakhs from related parties (exempt from deposit definition). Outstanding secured/unsecured loans from related parties exempt from deposit definition: Rs. 11,112.47 lakhs as on 31.03.2026. Loans from related parties are interest-free, repayable by 01.04.2030, with conversion option into equity/preference shares.
